question: Does the OpenCode free tier still answer on https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions, or only on https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions, and does any free model answer from outside the OpenCode client?
why: The docs page lists the /inference/openai/v1/ path and says free-tier chat models require OpenCode; a GET to either path returns 404 with an empty body, which does not discriminate. A keyed POST is needed and probe.py is GET-only. longcat-2.5-preview-free is no longer in the pricing table.
